crowd_clock_assumption: Source calendar date/hour interpreted as Australia/Melbourne local clock time; exact sensor DST and interval convention independently unverified.
missing_policy: Retain blank classes, raw observations and availability statuses. No zero filling or time interpolation.
shared_sensor_policy: Preserve eight primary sensors across 13 attractions. Never sum repeated shared-source values as independent visitors.
typical_profile_weather_join: Prohibited without recomputing from date/hour observations; weekly profiles have no particular date.
scores_policy: Convenience and comfort scores and recommendation rules are calculated by the group.
attraction_details_status: Pending team confirmation; draft categories are not final labels.
